slug.description: File name, URL name (/play/?g=<slug>) and asset name (games/<slug>.zip).

title.description: As the game names itself on its title screen.

platform.description: What the game runs on: ngage (the original N-Gage and N-Gage QD, a card dump; the default) or ngage2 (the N-Gage 2.0 service on an S60 3rd Edition phone, a .n-gage file).

uid.description: UID of the app the card launches, as the emulator reports it.

variantOf.description: Slug of the base game when this is a translation or mod of it (they share a UID).

dump.description: Folder name under games/ in a local checkout. Local only; the dumps are never committed.

pack.description: Fix-ups tools/games/pack.py applies when it builds the zip.

root.description: Card root inside the dump, when it cannot be found by looking for System/Apps.

move.description: [from, to] pairs relative to the card root, applied in order.

exclude.description: Extra glob patterns (matched against the path inside the card) to leave out.

borrow.description: [dump folder, path in that dump, path in this card]: files taken from another game's dump, for a dump that came without a library the cards of its time all carried.

folders.description: Folders the card must have although nothing is in them (a dump kept in git loses its empty folders).

file.description: N-Gage 2.0 only: the .n-gage file inside the dump, when the dump does not hold exactly one. A path may go into a .zip in the dump (Games/x.zip/game.n-gage).

status.description: How far the game gets in the web build: broken (does not start or crashes), boots (shows its own screens), menu (main menu works), ingame (playable).

statusNote.description: What was seen, in a sentence or two. Required when status is broken, boots or menu.

notes.description: Things a player should know (shown in the guide).

multiplayer.description: The game's multiplayer. null: the game's own menus were seen to have none. Left out: not known.

modes.description: bluetooth (hosting and joining over Bluetooth), arena (N-Gage Arena, Nokia's online service, which is gone), hotseat (several players on one device).

players.description: Most players over Bluetooth. Only where it is known.

menu.description: Where the game's own menu has it.

status.description: Bluetooth play on this site: untested, broken, connects (two players reach each other), plays.

statusNote.description: What was seen. Required when status is broken.

enhance.description: Drawing the game's 3D above its own resolution (docs/enhancements.md). Left out: the game has no enhancement profile.

engine.description: The profile that reads this game's rasteriser: catalog/enhance/<engine>.json.

status.description: experimental (the capture passes tools/re/enhancetest.py; the picture on the GPU layer was not looked at in play), verified (played at a higher resolution and the picture is right).

note.description: What is not right yet, or what a player should know.

source.description: Where the actions were learned: the game's own help or options screen, observed in play, or its manual.

actions.description: What each N-Gage key does in the game.

keyboard.description: N-Gage key -> KeyboardEvent.code list. Omit to use the standard layout.

gamepad.description: N-Gage key -> gamepad inputs: b<n> button, a<n>- / a<n>+ axis direction. Omit to use the standard layout.

expect.description: The level the script is expected to reach. The CI job fails when the game falls short of it.

script.description: Steps replayed after the game starts running, in order.

wait.description: Milliseconds to wait afterwards (default 600); with no key, a plain pause.

timeoutMs.description: How long the game may take to start running (default 90000).
